$comment: The one declaration of the Bun used by CI and Workers Builds.
canary follows GitHub's rolling canary, temporarily selected on 2026-10-06
to adopt bun check before the daily npm canary includes it.
The shared .github/install-bun.sh verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest and
the binary's full revision, then records them beside the installed binary.
Fresh installs can resolve different commits. The rolling runtime bypasses
the npm publication-age gate; dependency installation still uses bunfig.toml.
To return to an exact npm pin, declare a release or dated canary with its sha.
Do not add packageManager to package.json: Workers Builds cannot resolve
dated canaries there. Both build paths use this file and the shared installer.
